items.headline: Kalani Sitake, 'a BYU fan first,' emotional after Cougars' upset of Notre Dame
items.description: With a defensive stop that concluded in the end zone on the game's final play, No. 8 BYU outlasted No. 2 Notre Dame to preserve a riveting 28-24 victory Saturday, the Fighting Irish's first loss of the season and a win that moved to Cougars to 6-0.

items.headline: Bachmeier leads winning drive, No. 8 BYU outlasts No. 2 Notre Dame 28-24
items.description: — Bear Bachmeier threw a go-ahead touchdown pass with 1:47 left and No. 8 BYU stopped No. 2 Notre Dame at the goal line to preserve a riveting 28-24 victory Saturday night.
